data.name: RAEN: Survival Frontier
data.detailed_description:
RAEN: Survival Frontier is an online co-op survival game for 1–4 players.
Explore dangerous zones, collect valuable loot, and work together with your team to extract safely.

The world becomes far more lethal especially when night falls.
After sunset, creatures roam the darkness, reacting to sound and light as they hunt players.

In every mission, balancing risk and reward is the key to survival.
Deliver the loot you gather to the trader, upgrade your equipment, and prepare for the next, more dangerous run.

Key Features

  • 1–4 Player Online Co-op

  • Open-area exploration and looting

  • Extraction-based gameplay

  • Night-time creatures

  • Trader system and progression

  • Shelter and equipment upgrades

  • Team-based mini objectives

  • Day / night cycle

  • Survival mechanics (temperature, hunger, toxin exposure)

Staying outside at night is extremely risky.
Making too much noise or moving at the wrong time can quickly attract hostile creatures.

Coordinate with your team, extract valuable loot safely, and grow stronger with every run. 🔥

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD R7 370
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Designed to run at 720p on Low settings. Performance may vary depending on scene complexity and co-op activity.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Designed for 1080p on Medium–High settings with a more stable co-op experience.
